baseline: H0 current Champion C0/T1: M60 residual momentum EWMA(0.25) Long + equal-weight FD Short

trials.description: Fixed H0 Long; intraday-only 60-day momentum EWMA(0.25) Short
Fixed H0 Long; equal FD rank times low expected-skewness preference Short

feature_definitions.intraday_return: RawClose_t / RawOpen_t - 1 where both values are finite and strictly positive; signal-date t included
feature_definitions.intraday_momentum: 60 observed rows per listing segment, simple sum, min_periods=60; daily percentile rank mapped to [-1,1]; missing history neutral 0; EWMA alpha=0.25 adjust=False
feature_definitions.expected_skewness: monthly residual-return sample skewness/std/prior-month sum with at least 15 daily observations; MOM12_1 is monthly residual sum m-12 through m-2; OLS RS_m on complete X_(m-1), forecast X_m to m+1
feature_definitions.size_and_industry: omitted: no additional already-audited PIT predictor is required
feature_definitions.k1: daily FD percentile-rank * (1 - monthly ExpectedSkew percentile-rank); missing ExpectedSkew receives low-skew preference 0.5

model: No fitted alpha model. K1 expected-skewness uses deterministic monthly intercept-plus-four-predictor ordinary least squares with numpy.linalg.lstsq; rank-deficient or insufficient cross-sections forecast missing.

selection_rule.short_success: Short improvement folds >=3/4; median delta Short annual Net >0; pooled Short Net >H0
selection_rule.champion_replacement: Total pooled Net SR >H0; Total Net SR improvement folds >=3/4; long exact
